title: ClawPilot platform
summary: An authenticated application coordinates durable workspace data, operator-managed pipeline rows and narrowly scoped provider integrations.

notes.title: Different systems own different facts
notes.text: Postgres owns app records and durable jobs. Google Sheets remains the writable pipeline operator table; SuiteCRM is a CRM projection. Providers own their delivered mail, calendar events and posted accounting transactions.

notes.title: Documentation, not live discovery
notes.text: This source-reviewed map does not measure deployment health or prove provider-write enablement. Global architecture is restricted to the configured platform owner outside impersonation.

title: Commerce order intake
summary: Commerce candidates retain provider history and pass resolution and promotion gates before becoming canonical orders for warehouse planning.

notes.title: Readiness comes before execution
notes.text: Customer, product, address, delivery and source-evidence blockers must clear before canonical import. Warehouse release, complete picks, packing and verified label evidence remain separate gates.

notes.title: Shipment is not provider acknowledgment
notes.text: Provider fulfillment export is a separate durable outcome and can fail after local shipment confirmation. Universal live carrier dispatch is not complete: successful active-dispatch materialization still rejects with an explicit implementation gap.

title: Toast to QuickBooks
summary: Read-only Toast evidence and scoped QuickBooks references support accounting drafts, readiness review, approved posting or exact external-posting acknowledgment.

notes.title: A draft does not post
notes.text: Mappings and draft regeneration are preparation only. Posting requires source readiness, a current approved fingerprint, a verified connection and enabled write policy; deployed enablement is not inferred from this map.

notes.title: Existing postings require exact evidence
notes.text: External acknowledgment records existing same-date QuickBooks documents only after exact draft parity checks. It sends no new posting, and calculated card settlement does not establish a verified bank deposit.

title: CRM email lifecycle
summary: Reviewed sender selections and selected Gmail polling connect customer correspondence to permanent CRM references, durable interactions and guarded projections.

notes.title: Authentication messages stay out of CRM
notes.text: Confirmed ClawPilot and Career Desk sign-in notices are skipped before storage using exact sender, subject and producer-header or full-template evidence. Replies, forwards and ordinary customer code discussions remain eligible.

notes.title: Identity and association are rechecked
notes.text: Outbound delivery rechecks the reviewed organization/default or actor-owned sender. Polling uses the owner's selected mailbox; ambiguous participant matches remain unlinked. Durable intent is not a guarantee of exactly-once external delivery.

title: Meetings and Calendar
summary: A canonical CRM meeting and reviewed Calendar identity coordinate invitations, mode-specific join details and guarded bidirectional reconciliation.

notes.title: Calendar delivery is explicit
notes.text: Selection uses an organization default or a verified actor-owned writable calendar. Without a configured Calendar connection, a local meeting may remain unsent. Google Meet is requested only for Meet mode; in-person and custom-link modes keep their own requirements.

notes.title: Preserve identity and unsent intent
notes.text: Native edits retain the original delivered Calendar identity. Reverse sync reads linked events only and defers matching unresolved outbound updates; inaccessible or missing events do not prove cancellation.

title: Workspace and module access
summary: Active direct membership determines scoped permissions; session capabilities filter the shell while server module gates and resource access checks protect data and actions.

notes.title: Sidebar visibility is not authorization
notes.text: The shell denies missing or malformed capability payloads and refreshes after workspace changes. API module checks and resource editor/viewer rules remain separate; Pipeline and CRM share one view permission.

notes.title: Architecture has a stricter boundary
notes.text: Global architecture requires the active configured platform owner with no impersonation or identity mismatch. Organization-admin roles and the synthetic local-development user do not grant access; authorization precedes private artifact reads.

title: Domains and retained environments
summary: The documented host contract routes two production app origins to the same ClawPilot application and retains isolated on-demand development; this is dated documentation, not live DNS or runtime verification.

notes.title: Two hosts do not share a browser session
notes.text: The September 21, 2026 contract lists aiapp.eigenracing.com and aiapp.bposupplychain.com for the same production app. Cookies remain host-only; allowed browser returns preserve the chosen host while provider callbacks retain the canonical origin.

notes.title: Suspended means retained, not deleted
notes.text: September 21, 2026 documentation records suspended development with services, domains, data and credentials retained for approved test sessions. The BPO website short-link bridge was staged, not publicly activated; current state requires independent verification.
